title: Nicht zählen, sondern ins Verhältnis setzen
observableEvidence: sample limits and unclear cases acknowledged
no false precision from raw counts
requiredForStrong: uses a clear opportunity definition and target event
keeps conclusion scoped to the sample
avoids team identity and false precision
commonFailureModes: overconfident team claim from small sample
unclear situations treated as target events
fairnessNote: Excellent means excellent rate discipline for THIS drill — denominator honesty beats bigger numbers.
minimalInputChange: Required userConclusion (AI gate ≥40) plus ≥6 opportunity observations already usable.
